result.summary: Found 2 issues: one clear data/display bug and one layout problem where content is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The delivery fee under "Smash Bros Burgers" displays as "€NaN delivery", which indicates broken or missing pricing data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or fallback formatting so invalid values are not rendered; show a placeholder like "delivery info unavailable" if the fee can't be calculated.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the persistent bottom navigation bar, making the content look clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrolling content so cards are fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
